settings.receipts.policyHint: A receipt tells the sender you opened the message, and when. Even with “Always”, mail from a list or asking for the receipt to go somewhere else is asked about first, and mail in Junk is never answered.
settings.receipts.requestDelivery: Request a delivery receipt on new messages
settings.receipts.requestDeliveryHint: Asked of your outgoing server, only when it offers delivery notices; you are told when it does not. On Microsoft 365, only for accounts that allow changes, and not yet for messages with Bcc recipients or that are signed or encrypted. Exchange (EWS) accounts ask it in the request with each message.
settings.receipts.requestRead: Request a read receipt on new messages
settings.receipts.requestReadHint: Each message can still change it. The recipient decides whether to answer.
settings.receipts.title: Receipts
settings.replies.collapsePrefixesHint: Repeated reply or forward prefixes in the subject, in any language, become one.
settings.replies.forwardAttachments: Include the original’s attachments when forwarding
settings.replies.forwardModeHint: Inline quotes the message in the body; as attachment sends the original .eml file untouched.
settings.replies.headerHint: A one-line “On … wrote:”, or a From / Sent / To / Cc / Subject block as Outlook writes it.
settings.replies.includeOriginal: Include the original message in replies
settings.replies.includeOriginalHint: A reply opened in the full editor quotes the message it answers.
settings.replies.quoteStyleHint: HTML keeps the original’s formatting in an indented block; plain text puts “>” before every line.

notifications.remindersWhileQuietHint: Calendar and task reminders are time-critical, so they get through do not disturb unless this is off.
notifications.schedule.hint: Every week on the chosen days, in this computer’s time zone. An end before the start runs past midnight into the next day.

autoArchive.previewServer: The messages are moved on the server; other devices will see them in the Archive folder.
